profile.name: QuTech CC 中央控制器
profile.description: 一台机架式实验控制硬件，包含用于实时执行脉冲序列的 sequencer(s) 与与多个 CCIO（数字 I/O）通道。支持上传/汇编序列程序、启动/停止 sequencer、校准数字 I/O、设置 VSM（矢量切换矩阵）延时并读取调试寄存器与跟踪数据。主要用于超导量子比特等实验中对时序脉冲和数字信号的精确定时与协调。
profile.description_en: A rack-mounted laboratory control instrument providing real-time sequencers and multiple CCIO digital I/O channels. It accepts uploaded sequence programs (assembly), can start/stop sequencers, calibrate digital I/O lines, set VSM delay values, and read debug registers and traces. Used to generate and coordinate timed pulse sequences and digital signals in quantum experiments (e.g., superconducting qubit control).
